# B3b-LM-FIDELITY: Eigen::LevenbergMarquardt evaluation paths of 141 trace fits, as
# TraceFitter::optimize_ configures the solver (defaults, maxfev = budget), per oracle build.
# Problems: the 62 C2 fits of tests/data/lm_budget_differential/c2_trace_fits.txt (prefixed c2/,
# budget 500) and review_problems.txt (prefixed review/).
# outcome <oracle> <problem> <budget> <status> <nfev> <njev> <x,...> <evaluations> <path fnv1a64> <start fnorm>
# libfit <oracle> <problem> <ok|exception> <params,...>  (Gauss sigma is |x[2]|)
# path fnv1a64: FNV-1a 64 over the little-endian bytes of every residual-evaluation argument, NaN
# canonicalised to 7ff8000000000000. start fnorm: Eigen stableNorm of the residuals at x_init.
# oracle linux-x86_64-release: Linux x86_64, conda-forge gcc 14.4.0 -O3 -DNDEBUG -mssse3 -ffp-contract=off (the flags of TraceFitter.cpp in the Release build at /ceph/ibmi/abi/oliver/opt/openms4-release-bc9cc12-c19e494-174b576), conda-forge Eigen 5.0.1, SSE2/SSSE3 packets without FMA, glibc 2.39 exp; source results/linux/stock.out sha256 cdba4814d0d990227ecf4314f59c381b8d16c93e62ab55d13728686edc2a9564
